title: Content Marketing Output with AI
takeaway: Businesses using AI-assisted content creation see a 20% increase in content output.

data.label: Content Output Increase
data.evidence: Businesses using AI-assisted content creation often see a 20% increase in content output.

narration: AI can significantly reduce the time spent on content marketing. For example, a local bakery could use AI to generate a series of social media posts announcing a new seasonal pastry, saving hours of brainstorming and writing. Businesses using AI-assisted content creation often see a 20% increase in content output.
